SCANTIFIX AFFILIATE PROGRAM

15% Commission • 15% Customer Discount Code • $180+ Average Order Value • 180-Day Cookie Tracking • Recurring Subscription Commissions

ABOUT SCANTIFIX

Scantifix was founded by TK Jensen, a long-time peptide educator and founder of one of the largest peptide education communities online.

Our mission is simple: create products that we genuinely wish existed ourselves.

We specialize in premium peptide skincare, copper peptide hair care, red light therapy devices, microneedling tools, oral care products, and wellness solutions. Most of our products are unique formulations that simply do not exist elsewhere.

Unlike most brands, we focus heavily on transparency, testing, quality control, and customer education rather than marketing hype. We go the extra mile and do clinical trials on our products too!

WHAT MAKES SCANTIFIX DIFFERENT

• High-dose active ingredients and peptide concentrations
• Transparent formulations with disclosed ingredient amounts
• Clinical testing on select products
• USP 51 challenge testing on select formulations
• Dermatologist-supervised irritation testing
• Premium Dutch Miron Violet Glass packaging to help protect sensitive ingredients and eliminate concerns associated with plastic packaging
• Educational-first approach backed by over a decade of industry experience
• Unique products developed from real-world customer feedback and community input
• Hundreds of verified customer reviews and a rapidly growing customer base

HOW AFFILIATES EARN

Our affiliate program is designed to reward long-term partners.

• Earn 15% commission on every sale
• Average Order Value (AOV): $180+
• 180-day cookie tracking
• Earn recurring commissions on subscription renewals
• Every affiliate receives their own exclusive 15% discount code to share with their audience
• Create your own custom affiliate link
• Create your own custom coupon code
• Create direct links that automatically apply your coupon code at checkout
• Real-time affiliate dashboard and reporting

A $180+ average order value means affiliates earn approximately $27+ per sale on average before recurring subscription commissions are considered.

Unlike many affiliate programs that only pay on the first purchase, Scantifix affiliates continue earning commissions when referred customers remain subscribed. This creates the opportunity to build predictable recurring revenue over time.

HOW TO PROMOTE SCANTIFIX

Our best-performing affiliates focus on:

• Product reviews
• Educational skincare content
• Hair health content
• Red light therapy content
• Microneedling tutorials
• Wellness and longevity content
• Before-and-after content
• Social media videos
• Blog articles and newsletters

The most successful affiliates educate first and sell second.

AFFILIATE GROWTH PROGRAM

At Scantifix, we believe in helping our affiliates grow.

Affiliates who reach $1,000 in earned commissions may qualify for additional promotional opportunities.

If you create high-quality content featuring our products, our team may choose to run paid advertising behind your videos while keeping your affiliate code attached. This gives successful affiliates the opportunity to earn additional commissions from traffic and sales generated by our advertising efforts.

We view our affiliates as partners and actively look for ways to help them succeed.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

We handle product development, manufacturing, fulfillment, customer support, and customer satisfaction so you can focus on generating referrals and creating content.

Customer experience is one of our highest priorities. We go above and beyond to ensure every customer receives a 5-star Scantifix experience, and we do not hesitate to make things right when issues arise.

Our goal is simple: create customers who love our products and keep coming back, which benefits both Scantifix and our affiliates.

Verified customer reviews can be viewed here:

https://judge.me/reviews/stores/www.scantifix.com

Thank you for considering a partnership with Scantifix. We look forward to growing together.
